sprint_note: Adds a raw step stream, the CAD1 cadence estimator (server authoritative, phone mirror), run_metrics.cadence and ghost cadence_by_progress, a sample-accurate quiet metronome (Off / Match Ghost / Attack +2% / Manual) with a one-tap toggle, the race-screen left panel delta (gap history, 20 s pace, ghost section pace) and a web cadence stat/card; delta-only artifact (Sprint01/02 convention, see open_questions OQ6).
summary: Records the runner's steps, derives a robust cadence per run and per route position, lets the phone play a quiet metronome that matches or slightly attacks the raced ghost's recorded cadence, and presents a clearer live gap/pace/heart-rate racing view while keeping GPS and heart-rate recording unaffected.

classification.why_application: Running-domain meaning only: what a plausible cadence is, how missed step detections are tolerated without inventing steps, which ghost cadence applies at a route position, what 'match' and 'attack' mean. Cross-layer (as Sprint01/02): the native capture/audio/screen code lives in 01_System/AtlasPhone and its behavior is defined here. The only reusable pieces (step sensor listener, click audio output, one generic notification action) are deliberately domain-free device capabilities added to the existing Mobile Platform next to location and heart rate; everything with cadence/ghost meaning stays in package running.* and backend/.
non_goals: Ghost names/colors/identity, league, virtual pacers (roadmap Sprint 3)
Voice announcements, workout integration, any AI/ML processing
Backfilling cadence for existing runs (they stay cadence = NULL, 'no cadence recorded')
Deriving any cadence from speed or GPS, or inventing steps in raw storage
Audio-focus handling, ducking or pausing other audio
Cadence statistics in the phone recap or the history list (web run detail only)
Server-side or cross-device sync of metronome settings
classification.not_platform: Cadence estimation rules, ghost-cadence lookup and metronome targets are meaningful only to running. StepDetector, ClickEngine and QuickAction contain no running meaning (raw sensor events, a click at a given tempo, one labelled notification action) and are placed in the Mobile Platform exactly like LocationTracker/HeartRateMonitor; no change to 02_Platform, to the Dataset contract or to Blueprint.

consumes: Everything declared by Sprint01_RecordAndSync/10_architecture.json and Sprint02_RunFinishAndRecovery/10_architecture.json (Dataset contract, ApiError envelope, device-token native auth, V1 verification, A1 metrics, RS2 running-phase clipping, ghost profile/progress, Mobile Platform API); unchanged unless named below
01_System/AtlasPhone MobilePlatform: recorder (capture stays open through pause and recovery), location, heartRate, ensureForegroundService, stopAll, permissions
Android SensorManager TYPE_STEP_DETECTOR (permission ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION, API >= 29) and AudioTrack (no permission)
Existing phone ghost engine: GhostSession/GhostLive (progressM, reading.timeGapS), GhostCache.profile(), GhostComparison time-at-progress lookup
provides: Raw step events are stored unmodified as stream 'step' (one sample per step, event-time timestamp) and verified by V1 like location and heart rate; a run without steps (old phone, permission denied, no sensor) is unaffected in every other value.
Cadence is recalculable: run_metrics.cadence is derived data (CAD1, cadence.algo) and can be recomputed from the raw steps at any time; the raw rows are never changed by processing.
Missing cadence is never zero and never invented: gaps are absent series points / null values; no cadence is derived from speed; a ghost without recorded cadence is reported as such.
Server and phone compute CAD1 identically for the same steps (shared cadence_golden.json); the server value is the stored, authoritative one.

The metronome keeps time independently of UI refresh (sample-count scheduling on its own audio thread), changes target smoothly (slew limit), mixes with other audio (no audio focus request) and stops at Finish Run.
Existing runs, ghosts and phone builds without steps keep working: all schema and wire changes are additive and nullable/defaulted.
Step capture, metronome and chart updates never delay or block GPS/heart-rate recording (D7 reliability guard, invariant REL1).
invariants: S1 (step stream, draft D1/O1): one sample per detected step, HTTP stream name 'step', payload exactly SampleJson.step (type 'step.sample', captureId, sequence, timestamp, elapsedRealtimeNanos). payload.timestamp = sensor EVENT time as UTC (RawStep.timestampMillis, converted by StepDetector.toRaw so hardware batching does not shift it); the server uses run_samples.sample_ts, never arrival order or seq, for steps. Steps share the capture's single sequence counter with the other streams (V1 contiguity unchanged). Steps are recorded only while the phone is RECORDING: StepDetector is started at run start and Resume and stopped at Pause, Finish Run, legacy Finish, Discard and stopAll (so pauses and the recovery phase record no steps); the server additionally ignores steps outside [started_at, running end] and inside run_pauses (belt and braces, CAD1 step 1). Permission denied or no sensor: no step stream, nothing else changes, the home panel states it.

CAD1 (cadence estimator, draft D2; authoritative definition, implemented twice: Python backend/cadence.py and Kotlin CadenceEstimator; constants in scaffolding config.py / CadenceConfig; parity by tests/fixtures/cadence_golden.json). Input: step timestamps, pause intervals, run start, evaluation instant tau. (1) Kept steps = distinct timestamps within the running phase (>= started_at, <= running end = run_finished_at else finished_at else last step) and not inside any pause [start, end); steps on different sides of a pause are in different segments and never form an interval; state is reset at every segment start. (2) Causal replay: only steps with ts <= tau are known. The interval d_j = ts_j - ts_(j-1) (seconds) inside a segment is processed when step j+1 of the same segment is known (one-step lag; the last interval of a segment is never processed). (3) Window W = the last CAD_WINDOW_N accepted entries (interval value, corrected flag). M = median of W values (even count: mean of the two middle values) when len(W) >= CAD_MIN_INTERVALS, else undefined. (4) Classify d_j: GAP if d_j > CAD_GAP_S or (M defined and d_j > CAD_GAP_FACTOR*M): W is cleared, irregular streak = 0, previous-normal = false. Else if M undefined (warm-up): NORMAL iff 60/CAD_MAX_SPM <= d_j <= 60/CAD_MIN_SPM, else IRREGULAR. Else (M defined): NORMAL if |d_j - M| <= CAD_NORMAL_TOL*M; MISSED if |d_j - 2M| <= CAD_MISSED_TOL*2M AND the previous processed interval was NORMAL AND |d_(j+1) - M| <= CAD_NORMAL_TOL*M (next interval normal relative to the same M) - a MISSED interval adds two entries (d_j/2, corrected) and is never applied for multiples of 3 or more; otherwise IRREGULAR. NORMAL adds (d_j, not corrected). NORMAL and MISSED reset the irregular streak; IRREGULAR increments it, is excluded from W, and CAD_REANCHOR_IRREGULAR consecutive IRREGULAR intervals clear W (cadence re-anchors, e.g. running into walking). previous-normal is true only after a NORMAL interval. (5) Value at tau: null (gap) if no step <= tau in the current segment, or tau - (newest step <= tau) > CAD_GAP_S, or len(W) < CAD_MIN_INTERVALS; else spm = 60/M and conf = clamp(1 - 2*cv, 0, 1) * (1 - 0.5*corrected_fraction) with cv = population stdev / mean of the W values and corrected_fraction = corrected entries / len(W). spm is rounded to 0.1 and conf to 0.01. (6) Series: tau_k = started_at + k*CAD_SERIES_STEP_S while tau_k <= running end; a point {t = k*CAD_SERIES_STEP_S, spm, conf} exists only where the value is not null (gaps are absent). avg_spm = arithmetic mean of the series spm values rounded to 0.1, null when the series is empty. No steps are ever synthesised in raw storage; the 'two steps' of a MISSED interval exist only inside the estimator. Live phone display (LiveRunState.cadenceSpm) evaluates CAD1 over only the last LIVE_LOOKBACK_S seconds of steps and is a display approximation of the stored series.

CAD2 (stored cadence, draft D3): run_metrics.cadence is SQL NULL iff the running phase contains no kept step (S1/CAD1 step 1); otherwise the object {avg_spm: number|null, series: [{t, spm, conf}, ...], algo: CADENCE_ALGO_VERSION} (empty series + avg_spm null is valid: steps existed but none was usable). It is computed in compute_metrics for complete runs only, together with the other metrics, from the unclipped step rows restricted by CAD1 step 1. ALGO_VERSION is bumped so complete runs recompute on the next finish replay (existing rule); a legacy run recomputes to cadence NULL and otherwise unchanged values. Time authority: persisted phone UTC sample timestamps; series x = seconds since runs.started_at (same x basis as pace_series/hr_series); the server never reads its own clock (R-CON-AL-06).

GB1 (ghost cadence by progress, draft D3): when a run is matched onto its route (recompute_progress, which runs after recompute_and_store in the finish path and after a route link), run_route_progress.cadence_by_progress = [[bucket_start_m, spm], ...] derived as: take the run_metrics.cadence series points with conf >= CAD_PROFILE_MIN_CONF as (started_at + t, spm); for every PRE-trim profile point (moving time t, progress s) take the series point whose moving time (pauses removed, points inside pauses dropped) is nearest to t and within CAD_PROFILE_MAX_AGE_S, else no value; bucket by floor(s / CAD_PROGRESS_BUCKET_M); bucket value = mean of the values of its points rounded to 0.1; empty buckets are absent; ascending bucket_start_m. SQL NULL when cadence is NULL, the series is empty or no bucket results. Idle-start trimming does not change progress, so the bucket axis equals the profile's route position axis. Never derived from speed or from HR. If CADENCE_ALGO_VERSION changes, route-linked runs need recompute_progress (deferred decision).

MET1 (metronome, draft D4/O2-O5; all constants in scaffolding MetronomeConfig/ClickConfig): modes MetronomeMode OFF | MATCH_GHOST | ATTACK_102 | MANUAL, default OFF on first use, mode/manual cadence/volume persisted locally in RunSettings and restored for the next run (an unavailable restored mode becomes OFF). rawTarget: MATCH_GHOST = ghost cadence at the runner's current route progress (GB1 lookup of the MAIN ghost's cached profile); ATTACK_102 = that value x ATTACK_FACTOR; MANUAL = the manual cadence (default 170); OFF = none; a value outside [MIN_TARGET_SPM, MAX_TARGET_SPM] counts as none. No ghost cadence (old ghost, no steps, progress unknown because waiting for start / off course / GPS lost): rawTarget is none and nothing is derived from speed; the chip states 'No cadence recorded for this ghost' (ghost known, list absent) and offers 'Use manual cadence' (selects MANUAL). TargetSmoother output: first raw value as is, then slew-limited to SLEW_SPM_PER_S, raw none holds the last output for HOLD_S then silence; reset on mode change. The 1 Hz publish tick computes the smoothed target and writes it atomically to ClickEngine; the audio thread never waits for it, so a stalled UI/publish leaves the last target playing (REL1). ClickEngine: streaming AudioTrack, pre-rendered short quiet click, beats scheduled by sample count with fractional accumulation (BeatScheduler), no timers, no audio-focus request (mixes with music/podcasts), default volume DEFAULT_VOLUME with a persisted volume setting. Lifecycle: starts at run start/recover only when mode != OFF (and on first switch to a non-OFF mode), stays alive through a pause but is silent while PAUSED (the tick hands target none to the engine and resets the smoother; it resumes from the raw target after Resume), stops at Finish Run, legacy Finish, Discard and stopAll (O4: not during recovery). Quick toggle: MetronomeChip on the race screen and the free-run cockpit (one tap = next available mode, MetronomeTarget.next) and one notification action on the foreground notification (QuickAction label 'Click: <mode>', O5) that calls the same cycleMode; both persist the mode.

RC1 (race screen delta, draft D5; display only, derived from data the engine already has): audited against roadmap section 3 on the existing code. Already implemented and only to be kept: map + portrait layout, current gap (GapLine, negative = ahead), gaining/losing arrow (GapTrend), my HR with HR2 smoothing (default 5 s) and ghost HR aligned by route position (hrByProgress / HrDistanceChart, ghostHrSeries), distinct user/ghost colours. NEW (the delta): (a) 1-2 minute gap history (LiveTrends.gapSeries, window GAP_HISTORY_S); (b) 20 s rolling pace as its own value (LiveMetrics.racePaceSPerKm, window RACE_PACE_WINDOW_S; the existing 120 s 'Last 2 min' rolling pace and A1.ROLLING_PACE_WINDOW_S stay unchanged); (c) ghost section pace (RaceChart.ghostSectionPace over the route section covered in the last RACE_PACE_WINDOW_S); (d) left/right split of the lower area: left = RaceGapPanel, right = existing HrDistanceChart. Gap and pace are never plotted on a shared axis (gap = line chart of seconds, paces = two text figures). Unknown values render as the existing dash, never 0.

REL1 (reliability guard, draft D7): StepDetector callbacks only emit into a buffered flow (no store access, no locking); CaptureRecorder collects steps on the IO dispatcher like the other streams; the RunController steps collector holds the controller lock only for an in-memory append; ClickEngine runs on its own URGENT_AUDIO thread fed from sample counts and two atomics; chart derivations run inside the existing 1 Hz publish and never on the sensor or audio threads. A drop in chart refresh must not change click timing (BeatSchedulerTest independence from buffer size and target hand-off tests).

T3 (time authority, R-CON-AL-06): all persisted times are phone-reported UTC (step event time converted on the phone; capture of the offset between event and arrival happens once at conversion). Server cadence/ghost-cadence derivations use only stored sample timestamps, pauses and runs.started_at/run_finished_at/finished_at. Metronome smoothing uses the phone wall clock passed into the pure functions for display/audio only; nothing persisted.

C2 (compatibility / deploy order): FinishRequest/SampleIn forbid unknown values, therefore the server MUST be deployed before a phone build that uploads step samples (stream 'step' would be 422 on an old server). The phone omits expected_counts.step when the step count is 0, so a new phone without steps still works against an old server. An old phone against the new server works unchanged (step omitted = 0; responses gain a 'step' key that the old phone's parser ignores). Cached ghost profiles without cadence_by_progress decode with null. RunMeta JSON is unchanged.

P3 (durable state, R-CON-BP-03): Postgres: run_samples rows with stream 'step' (raw, owner RunningTracker, same lifecycle as other samples), run_metrics.cadence and run_route_progress.cadence_by_progress (derived/recomputable), constraint ck_run_samples_stream (10_schema.sql, runtime copy 03_Application/RunningTracker/schema.sql). Phone: step samples in the CaptureStore buffer (existing durable buffer, purged after verified sync), captures.step_count (SQLite schema version 3, additive column), SharedPreferences atlas_run_settings keys metronome_mode, manual_cadence_spm, click_volume (not secret, never uploaded). The in-memory recent-step list, TargetSmoother and LiveHistory gap buffer are ephemeral display state (R-CON-BP-03 allowed operational state).

Q3 (query behavior, R-CON-AL-01/-02): see the query field of each exposed surface. Series metric cadence takes no pagination, orders by t ASC, has the empty case (empty Dataset, total 0 for a run with cadence NULL, an empty series, or still uploading) and the unknown-run case (404 NOT_FOUND) for every run state (uploading, complete with cadence, complete without steps, legacy). RunRow.avg_cadence_spm is null for the same cases.

N4 (no regression): the existing Free Run, prepared run, ghost race, recovery, upload, V1, HR smoothing and recap paths behave as before when no steps exist; the 120 s rolling pace, GapTrend, HrDistanceChart and ST1 standing are untouched; MobilePlatform's existing public members keep their signatures (only additions), TWA/FCM untouched.
failure_modes: ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION denied/blocked or no step-detector sensor: StepDetector.state NO_PERMISSION / NO_SENSOR, no step samples, cadence NULL, MATCH/ATTACK modes of the user's own future runs unaffected (they depend on the GHOST's cadence), live user cadence shows a dash; the run records normally. Consumer: the home panel note; no retry loop.

Old ghost or ghost recorded without steps: cadence_by_progress null; modes MATCH_GHOST/ATTACK_102 stay silent and the chip shows 'No cadence recorded for this ghost' + 'Use manual cadence'; never a speed-derived fallback.

Ghost cadence gap at the current position (bucket gap, off course, GPS lost, waiting for start): raw target none; the previous smoothed target is held for HOLD_S then silence until data returns, then restarts from the new raw value.
ClickEngine cannot create/write the AudioTrack (ERROR state): metronome silent, chip shows the engine state, recording unaffected; user can toggle to retry.
No headphones connected: the click plays through whatever route the system chooses, including the phone speaker (no guard built, OQ5); user sets mode OFF or volume 0.
Another app takes the audio output exclusively or the system mutes background audio of the foreground service: click may stop; device verification item (OQ4), not detectable in JVM tests.

422 VALIDATION_ERROR on PUT /native/runs/{id}/samples with stream 'step' or on finish with expected_counts.step from an OLD server (deploy-order violation, C2): the phone keeps the run pending_upload with the existing visible error; resolution is deploying the server.
count_mismatch for stream 'step' at finish (expected vs stored): the existing V1 incomplete path (retry/resume), same handling as for the other streams.
Step samples outside the running phase or inside pauses reach the server (old buffer, clock skew): ignored by CAD1 step 1, still stored raw and counted by V1.

Steps present but too irregular (stumbling, walking mixed in, sensor misses > 2x): series partially or entirely absent, avg_spm null, never zero; web card shows 'No cadence recorded.' for an empty series.
404 NOT_FOUND GET /runs/{id}/series for an unknown run; 422 for a metric outside pace|heart_rate|recovery_hr|cadence (unchanged envelope).

Capture buffer full (maxUnackedPerCapture 100000 unacked per capture; ~17k samples/hour with steps): existing Overflow behavior (sample refused, counted in dropped), now reached after roughly 5.5 h instead of 8 h; surfaced through the existing dropped count.

Process death during a run: the click stops with the process; Recover (existing) restarts GPS/HR as before, StepDetector stays stopped until Resume (recover enters PAUSED), the metronome restarts from persisted mode at begin().

consumes: AtlasPhone MobilePlatform (see contracts.consumes); CaptureStore.fetch/info for upload
platform-ui: apiFetch, Dataset types, LineChart (web run detail)
provides: Native documentation updates: 01_System/AtlasPhone/Sprint01_MobilePlatform/MobilePlatform_API.md (steps, click, quickAction, Stream.STEP, CaptureStore v3) and 01_System/AtlasPhone/Sprint02_RunningScreen/RunningScreen_API.md (upload, ghost cadence, metronome, race screen), tags [tested: JVM] / [built] / [unverified]
Kotlin APIs: MobilePlatform.steps / click / quickAction, RunController.cycleMetronome / selectMetronomeMode / setManualCadence / setClickVolume (signatures in 10_scaffolding.json)
Compose controls MetronomeChip and RaceGapPanel (native, not Dataset: R-CON-BP-04 governs HTTP read endpoints only)

exposed_surfaces.name: PUT /api/runningtracker/native/runs/{id}/samples
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Existing idempotent sample upload; accepts stream 'step'.
exposed_surfaces.ui_contract: none (machine-to-machine, exempt from Dataset; typed record SamplesResponse | ApiError, unchanged)
exposed_surfaces.query: SampleIn.stream gains 'step'; payload must carry payload.timestamp (ISO-8601 UTC) exactly like the other streams (S1). SamplesResponse.high_seq gains the key step (StreamCounts). Duplicates (run_id, stream, seq) are ignored as before.

exposed_surfaces.name: POST /api/runningtracker/native/runs/{id}/finish
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Existing verified finish; V1 now covers three streams and the complete-run metrics include cadence.
exposed_surfaces.query: expected_counts (StreamCounts) gains optional step (default 0; the phone omits it when 0, C2). FinishResponse.verified_counts and high_seq gain the key step. count_mismatch may name stream 'step'. On result 'complete', recompute_and_store writes run_metrics.cadence per CAD2 and recompute_progress writes cadence_by_progress per GB1. No other finish behavior changes (idempotent replay, run_finished_at rules of Sprint02).

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/runningtracker/native/runs/{id}/ghost-profile
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Ghost profile for the phone cache; gains the ghost's cadence along the route.
exposed_surfaces.query: Unchanged parameters and 404 rule (qualified profiles only). Response gains key cadence_by_progress: array of [bucket_start_m, spm] pairs ascending by bucket_start_m (20 m buckets, empty buckets absent) or null (GB1: no usable cadence). Existing keys and the points shape are unchanged, so old phones ignore the new key.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/runningtracker/runs and GET /api/runningtracker/runs/{id}
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Run list/detail Dataset gains the average cadence of the running phase.
exposed_surfaces.query: Parameters, defaults, ordering and pagination unchanged (Sprint01). RunRow gains avg_cadence_spm: number|null (= run_metrics.cadence.avg_spm; null when cadence is NULL, avg_spm null, or the run has no metrics). New nullable column in RUN_SCHEMA (additive, non-breaking per R-CON-BP-04 stability rule).

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/runningtracker/runs/{id}/series
exposed_surfaces.query: Param metric: pace | heart_rate | recovery_hr | cadence (required; anything else/missing -> 422). cadence: points = run_metrics.cadence.series, x = seconds since started_at, value = spm (SeriesRow shape of Sprint01, object_type 'run_series', label 'Cadence'; t_label by the existing label function); ordered by t_s ASC; empty Dataset when cadence is NULL or the series is empty or the run has no metrics yet; 404 if the run does not exist. Confidence is not exposed. Chart mapping as for the other metrics (x t_label, y value, aggregation avg). Other metrics unchanged.

exposed_surfaces.name: MobilePlatform.steps / click / quickAction
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Domain-free device capabilities (step events, click audio output, one notification action); signatures in 10_scaffolding.json (mobile/steps, mobile/audio, mobile/service).

exposed_surfaces.name: RunController metronome members and LiveRunState.cadenceSpm / metronome
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Running-level control and state for the metronome and the live user cadence; signatures in 10_scaffolding.json (running/session/RunController.kt).

exposed_surfaces.name: Race screen left panel + MetronomeChip (phone, Compose)
exposed_surfaces.purpose: GhostRaceScreen: lower area split into RaceGapPanel (gap, trend arrow, 1-2 min gap history, 20 s pace, ghost section pace) and the existing HR chart; MetronomeChip (one-tap mode, target, 'no cadence recorded' notice with manual fallback, manual cadence stepper, volume). LiveCockpit hosts the chip for free runs (OFF/MANUAL).

exposed_surfaces.name: Run detail page (web, existing RunDetailPage)
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Adds an 'Avg cadence' stat and a Cadence chart card from RunRow.avg_cadence_spm and series metric cadence; 'No cadence recorded.' when empty; nothing else changes. No new pages.

internal_flow.name: finish_run (server, delta to Sprint01 step 7 / Sprint02)
internal_flow.description: V1 verification and the idempotent replay now consider three streams; on result 'complete' recompute_and_store additionally computes and stores run_metrics.cadence (step 19) and recompute_progress stores cadence_by_progress (step 20) after the metrics are written.

internal_flow.name: serve_history (delta to Sprint01 step 8)
internal_flow.description: RunRow adds avg_cadence_spm; series adds metric cadence (reads run_metrics.cadence.series, empty Dataset on NULL/empty, 404 unknown run, 422 unknown metric).

internal_flow.name: phone_record_and_sync (delta to Sprint01 step 9)
internal_flow.description: Upload batches are stream-agnostic, so step samples ride the existing PUT /samples flow (stream name from Stream.apiName); expected counts include the step count (omitted when 0); step samples are acknowledged and purged like the others.

internal_flow.name: phone_step_capture
internal_flow.description: RunController.start (and resume) requests nothing itself: the UI start path asked ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION once at first use (result ignored for starting). RunController then calls platform.steps.start(); on false the run continues without steps. StepDetector emits RawStep (event time via toRaw) into a buffered flow; CaptureRecorder stores them as Stream.STEP with the shared sequence. pause(), finishRun(), finish(), discard() and stopAll call steps.stop() (flush then unregister). A RunController collector keeps the last LIVE_LOOKBACK_S seconds of step times in memory for step 25.
outputs: step samples in the capture buffer

internal_flow.name: compute_cadence_server
internal_flow.description: Inside compute_metrics: build the kept step list (CAD1 step 1) from step rows, run CAD1 series with end = run_finished_at else finished_at, derive avg_spm; result None (SQL NULL) when no kept step exists. recompute_and_store routes rows by stream (location / heart_rate / step) so step rows never enter heart-rate computations.

internal_flow.name: ghost_cadence_by_progress
internal_flow.description: recompute_progress reads run_metrics.cadence, filters by CAD_PROFILE_MIN_CONF, passes (ts, spm) points to build_progress which derives cadence_by_progress per GB1 from the pre-trim profile; stored next to the profile (SQL NULL when absent); native_get_ghost_profile returns it as cadence_by_progress. Runs without route/without completed status keep the existing delete-row behavior.

internal_flow.name: phone_metronome_target
internal_flow.description: Once per publish (1 Hz, RunController): ghost progress from GhostLive.progressM (null while waiting/off course/GPS lost) -> MetronomeTarget.ghostCadenceAt on the main ghost's cadenceByProgress -> MetronomeTarget.rawTarget(mode, ghost, manual) -> TargetSmoother.update -> ClickEngine.setTargetSpm (atomic) and MetronomeState into LiveRunState. While the run is PAUSED the tick hands target none (silence) to the engine and resets the smoother; mode OFF stops the engine.

internal_flow.name: click_engine_audio
internal_flow.description: ClickEngine thread: loop { read target + volume atomics; BeatScheduler.fill(buffer, frames, target); AudioTrack.write } with fractional-accumulation beat spacing; target null = silence; no audio focus; stop() releases the track. Independent of UI/publish timing.
outputs: PCM click stream to the system audio output

internal_flow.name: metronome_quick_toggle
internal_flow.description: MetronomeChip tap or the notification QuickAction calls RunController.cycleMetronome -> MetronomeController.cycleMode: MetronomeTarget.next(current, hasGhost), persist via RunSettings, reset smoother, start/stop engine, update the QuickAction label ('Click: <mode>'); the notice button calls selectMetronomeMode(MANUAL); manual cadence and volume setters persist and forward. Metronome stops (engine stop, QuickAction cleared) at finishRun, finish, discard, stopAll.

internal_flow.name: race_chart_derivations
internal_flow.description: Inside the existing publish: LiveHistory.record additionally appends the time gap to gapSeries (window GAP_HISTORY_S, only while ON_COURSE and not paused), keeps (moving s, progress m), and computes ghostSectionPaceSPerKm via RaceChart.ghostSectionPace(profile, progress RACE_PACE_WINDOW_S ago, progress now); LiveMetrics.racePaceSPerKm comes from the accumulator. RaceGapPanel renders them; HR side unchanged.

internal_flow.name: live_user_cadence
internal_flow.description: Display only: in publish, CadenceEstimator.at(recent step times, current pauses, now) -> LiveRunState.cadenceSpm (null = gap/warm-up/no steps); shown as 'you N' in the MetronomeChip. Never persisted, never uploaded, not used for the metronome target.

internal_flow.name: web_cadence_view
internal_flow.description: RunDetailPage loads /series?metric=cadence with the existing requests, shows the Avg cadence stat from RunRow.avg_cadence_spm and the Cadence card (LineChart) or 'No cadence recorded.'; an ApiError in the new request shows the existing ErrorCard.

internal_required.role: Native host: Mobile Platform additions (StepDetector, ClickEngine, QuickAction, CaptureStore v3, permissions, manifest) and running package code (file list in 10_scaffolding.json)
LineChart/apiFetch for the web cadence card (consumed only; no Shell file changes, no nginx change)
schema runningtracker, additive constraint replacement and columns

external_required.name: none new
external_required.role: No new Python, npm or Gradle dependency; Android SDK classes SensorManager and AudioTrack only; JVM tests use the existing JUnit setup

forbidden: Any change to network exposure (no new port, no nginx change; native routes stay tailnet-only)
Domain logic (CAD1, ghost cadence, metronome targets) in 02_Platform or inside the domain-free Mobile Platform classes
Audio-focus requests (AUDIOFOCUS_*), ducking or pausing other apps' audio (O2)
Any cadence derived from speed, GPS or heart rate; synthesising steps in raw storage; zero-filling missing cadence
New runtime permissions other than ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION; ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION requested before first use or repeatedly without a user tap
Deleting or rewriting raw step samples; backfilling cadence for old runs
Server clock for step/cadence time; uploading metronome settings

risks.risk: Step capture and audio rely on the foreground service (location|connectedDevice) while the screen is off; behavior of TYPE_STEP_DETECTOR delivery and of AudioTrack playback from that service is unverified on hardware.
risks.impact: Steps could stop arriving or the click could be muted with the screen locked; mitigated by gap-tolerant CAD1 (cadence NULL, run unaffected), the Recover path, and the manual device acceptance scenarios; no service type change until evidence exists.

risks.risk: Kotlin and Python implement CAD1 separately (like A1 and HRR1).
risks.impact: Phone live cadence could differ from the stored server cadence; limited by the shared cadence_golden.json and by the server being authoritative; the live value is labelled display-only and uses a lookback approximation.

risks.risk: The step sensor misses or double-reports steps on some devices; CAD1 corrects only isolated single misses.
risks.impact: Cadence series have gaps or reduced confidence on such devices; ghost-match is then silent for those ghosts rather than wrong (by design).

risks.risk: A new phone build against an old server fails on step upload (422) or on expected_counts.step.
risks.impact: Run stays pending_upload with a visible error; avoided by deploy order C2 (server first); a run without steps keeps working against an old server because step is omitted when 0.

risks.risk: Raw step volume (~10k samples/hour) raises sample counts per run and upload size, and shortens the time until the 100k unacked buffer limit (about 5.5 h).
risks.impact: Larger uploads and a lower overflow threshold for very long runs; accepted (single user, runs far below the limit); batching is a deferred decision.

risks.risk: The click is audible through the phone speaker if headphones are absent or disconnect mid-run (no speaker guard, OQ5).
risks.impact: Social annoyance only; mitigated by very low default volume, one-tap Off and the notification action.

risks.risk: Persisting the metronome mode means the next run may start clicking without a fresh decision (OQ3).
risks.impact: Unexpected audio at run start; mitigated by a visible chip and the notification label; changeable to default OFF per run without schema impact.

risks.risk: Replacing the run_samples stream constraint scans the table once on the first startup after deploy.
risks.impact: A short lock/validation delay at that startup; single-user data volume makes it negligible; the statement is idempotent afterwards.

open_questions.question: OQ1 Draft section 3/D2 gives the phone a CadenceEstimator but no phone consumer. This design uses it for a display-only 'you N' value in the MetronomeChip (live user cadence). Confirm, or drop LiveRunState.cadenceSpm and keep the Kotlin estimator only for parity tests. Default applied: shown in the chip, not persisted.

OQ2 Draft modes are OFF | MATCH_GHOST | ATTACK_102 plus an 'offered' manual fallback for ghosts without cadence. This design models the fallback as a fourth mode MANUAL (default 170 spm, adjustable, persisted) so free runs without a ghost can also use a fixed click, and the one-tap cycle is OFF > MATCH_GHOST > ATTACK_102 > MANUAL (ghost modes omitted without a ghost session). Confirm. Default applied.

OQ3 The metronome mode is persisted across runs (a returning runner usually wants the same mode). Alternative: always start OFF. Default applied: persisted, restored at run start, chip and notification label make the state visible.

OQ4 Verify on a device (screen locked, music playing) that TYPE_STEP_DETECTOR events and the AudioTrack click keep flowing from the existing location|connectedDevice foreground service; if Android mutes the click or stops steps, a mediaPlayback/health service type may be needed (out of scope to pre-build).
OQ5 No speaker guard is built (the click follows the system audio route). Confirm that a click on the phone speaker when headphones disconnect is acceptable for this sprint.

OQ7 Draft D3 sketched the stored series as ~1 Hz objects. This design evaluates CAD1 every CAD_SERIES_STEP_S = 5 s (same x basis and bucket as pace_series/hr_series, about 720 points per hour instead of 3600) and stores point objects {t, spm, conf}; live display evaluates on demand. Default applied; revert to a finer step only if the web chart needs it (changes only the constant, ALGO_VERSION bump).
